milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: 1.84x barrier surge; GENERIC 76.8% defect reduction; uncalibrated 1 ps Kramers-Moyal SDE predicted MFPT.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Saddle surge is a short-time artifact (2.90x at 1 ps, monotonic at Markovian lags). 1D D(Q) scales as tau^-0.70 (non-Markovian memory). With memory time tau*=50 ps, U->F is 789 vs 752 ps, and F->U PREDICTION is 1047 vs 911 [683, 1245] ps (within 95% CI).
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: Reference structure used frame 0 instead of native PDB; Kramers-Moyal at 1 ps clipped trajectories; ignored memory kernel decay in Q.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: Sidechains provide +14.7% 'total mutual information'; Rep A = 12.87 nats, Rep B = 14.76 nats.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Total discrete entropy H(Y) is only 0.865 nats. True variational MI lower bound is 0.410 nats (Backbone) vs 0.462 nats (+12.8%). Subspace overlap is 1.0000.
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: M22 summed 1D marginal continuous mutual informations, double-counting correlated features and reporting a sum exceeding total entropy by 10x.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: Spatial correlation decays exponentially (xi ~ 0.20); contact gating claimed; evaluated on Villin only.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Power law Delta^-beta fits superior to exponential on all 5 proteins (Delta AIC < 0 across all systems; GB1 Delta AIC = -44). Coupling number is strictly bounded (k_eff = 3.1-4.9 partners/dihedral). Contact gating strongly confirmed controlling for sequence separation (p=0.0005, enrichment 2.1-3.9x).
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: Villin power-law SSR (0.00029) was lower than exponential (0.00067), yet exponential was claimed; paired psi_i with phi_{i+1}; did not control for sequence adjacency.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: Sublinear rank r90 ~ d^0.84 claimed; O(N d w) complexity claimed; table hardcoded Ala, Tri, Chignolin, Trp-cage.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Sublinear scaling rigorously proved: alpha = 0.887 [CI: 0.830, 0.950] with P(alpha < 1) = 99.95%. Independent null has alpha = 0.998. Banded estimator scales as O(d^0.99) (exact linear), achieving 28.0x speedup at d=2400.
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: Original M24 script hardcoded rank values for 4 systems; timing was measured on sliced GB1 columns rather than varied proteins.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: Claimed r = -0.741 correlation with RMSF; 1 us propagation in PCA space; 1.2 ps 'metastable' states.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Mobility positively correlates with core-aligned RMSF on all 5 proteins (Villin r_s = 0.40, p=0.027; GB1 r_s = 0.58, p=5e-6; Ubiquitin r_s = 0.43, p=1e-4). Validated against X-ray B-factors on Ubiquitin (r_s = 0.272, p=0.019, N=74). Linear Langevin generator in r90 modes is stable across all proteins; 1 us exact propagation conserves variance (ratio 1.0007-1.0050, KL < 0.005).
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: Monograph fabricated r = -0.741 (code produced +0.313 due to unaligned RMSF); drift was hand-set to -0.05; 1 us propagation was only 5000 steps.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: 70-78.6% transfer accuracy claimed with isotropic scalar predictor and hardcoded 0.015 coupling.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: Native secondary structure + burial predicts diagonal mobility with r_s = 0.64, R^2 = 0.41 (LOPO across all folds). Universal interior mobility plateau verified: Helix (0.038 rad^2/ps, CV 16%), Strand (0.049, CV 5%), Coil (0.063, CV 13%). Relative Frobenius error reduced from 77.9% (original M26) to 51.6% (model).
milestone_audit_verdicts.diagnostic_flaw: Original predictor asserted 70-78% accuracy by subtracting ~84% error from 100%; used unphysical constant coupling.

milestone_audit_verdicts.original_claim: D_KL <= 1.40 < 0.15 self-contradiction; internal friction gamma_int ~ 0.35 ps^-1 asserted without calculation.
milestone_audit_verdicts.rigorous_result: When evaluated like-with-like (folded frames only), zero-parameter linear equipartition D(T) = D_340 * (T/340) predicts probe mobilities with only 5.5% mean relative error (280 K: 5.5%, 300 K: 4.3%, 360 K: 6.8%).
